question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Siddhartha, Bob gets The Trial, Claire gets Ivanhoe, Dave gets The Hobbit, Eve gets Dracula, Fred gets Middlemarch, and Gertrude gets Candide.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Eve and Claire swap books. Then, Gertrude and Eve swap books. Then, Alice and Eve swap books. Then, Alice and Eve swap books. Then, Claire and Fred swap books. Then, Claire and Bob swap books. Finally, Claire and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Siddhartha
(B) The Trial
(C) Ivanhoe
(D) The Hobbit
(E) Dracula
(F) Middlemarch
(G) Candide
solution:
Owners in each row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: Siddhartha | The Trial | Ivanhoe | The Hobbit | Dracula | Middlemarch | Candide
1. Eve ↔ Claire: Siddhartha | The Trial | Dracula | The Hobbit | Ivanhoe | Middlemarch | Candide
2. Gertrude ↔ Eve: Siddhartha | The Trial | Dracula | The Hobbit | Candide | Middlemarch | Ivanhoe
3. Alice ↔ Eve: Candide | The Trial | Dracula | The Hobbit | Siddhartha | Middlemarch | Ivanhoe
4. Alice ↔ Eve: Siddhartha | The Trial | Dracula | The Hobbit | Candide | Middlemarch | Ivanhoe
5. Claire ↔ Fred: Siddhartha | The Trial | Middlemarch | The Hobbit | Candide | Dracula | Ivanhoe
6. Claire ↔ Bob: Siddhartha | Middlemarch | The Trial | The Hobbit | Candide | Dracula | Ivanhoe
7. Claire ↔ Bob: Siddhartha | The Trial | Middlemarch | The Hobbit | Candide | Dracula | Ivanhoe
Claire has Middlemarch, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
